title: Namaz of Imam Muhammad Taqi Jawad (a.s.)
categoryChain: Namaz of Imam Muhammad Taqi Jawad (a.s.)

verses.translation: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and Surah al-Tawheed is repeated seventy times. After the namaz recite the dua of Imam Al Jawad (a.s.):
